newsitem.title: SRI LANKA: Sri Lanka rupee ends lower as dollar gains.
newsitem.headline: Sri Lanka rupee ends lower as dollar gains.

text.p: The Sri Lanka rupee closed lower against the dollar on Friday, in line with overseas dollar gains, dealers said.
The rupee closed at its opening level of 58.80 to the dollar, after moving to a low of 58.92 and a high of 58.87. The rupee closed at 58.50 on Thursday.
"There was hardly any demand for dollars. The currency opened high due to overseas gains and maintained its strength," said a standrad Chartered Bank dealer.
The central bank pushed up the dollar by four local cents, fixing buying and selling prices at 58.7392 and 59.9258.
Overnight call money closed at 10.25 percent, after opening at 11.5, dealers said.
